bear_scenario.label: bear
bear_scenario.narrative_en: Risk case: volatility (~12% annualised) expands, relative strength rolls over, and Global X Russell 2000 Covered Call lags the market on any risk-off turn.

recommendations.dissent_summary: Bull case: in a strong advance the underlying (IWM) typically out-totals a covered-call wrapper; high yield is not outperformance.

recommendations.one_line_thesis_en: Global X Russell 2000 Covered Call: HOLD (short) — score 44/100, conf 54%.

recommendations.rationale_en: We read Global X Russell 2000 Covered Call as a hold on the short horizon — composite score 44/100, 54% confidence. Above all, positive relative strength vs the S&P 500.
